# logos.config
files:
  show_extensions: [.py, .yaml, .md, .txt, .json, .png]
  max_depth: 5
  inline_meta_masks: ['*.meta', README.md]
memory_policy:
  enabled: true
  max_cells: 64
  max_tokens: 24567
  untouchable_tail: 8
  min_cells_to_summarize: 16
  summarizable_types: [me, py_result, py_async, human, human_stt]
  age_weight: 0.75
  size_weight: 0.25
  max_contiguous_summaries: 4
system: {save_state_on_loop: true}
vision:
  hook_captures:
    - source: astra
      active: true
      view: true
      var_name: astra_img
      resolution: [480, 640]
      astra_feeds: [rgb, depth_registered]
    - source: pan_tilt
      active: true
      view: true
      var_list_name: pt_seq
      pt_sequence:
        - pan: 0
          tilt: 0
          resolution: [600, 800]
        - pan: 0
          tilt: -60
          resolution: [288, 384]
    - {source: theoria, active: true, view: true, var_name: theoria}
map3d:
  rgb_image_topic: /camera/rgb/image_raw
  rgb_info_topic: /camera/rgb/camera_info
  points_topic: /camera/depth_registered/points
  map_topic: /map
  base_frame: base_footprint
  map_frame: [map, odom, rgd_optical_frame]
  default_resolution: [640, 640]
  max_cloud_height_m: 2.0
  include_robot: true
  point_hit_radius: 0.05
  ray_infinity_distance_m: 50.0
  mind_palace_config: config/mind_palace_00.yaml
  phantasmata_dir: phantasmata/
theoria:
  resolution: [768, 768]
  camera_pos_relative:
    - [-1.0, 1.0, 2.0]
  look_at_relative:
    - [1.0, 0, 0.35]
